scope: software integration development fixture; no efficacy or held-out confirmation claim
objective: total predicted outbound observation gain; return route is a feasibility reserve only
initial_state: one measured RGB-D plus scan frame, otherwise unknown map
return_anchor: initial robot cell and heading, fixed for the complete episode
gates: all four existing component interfaces called and causally linked
at least two global selections followed by actual paid actions
each fresh sensor packet fused and charged exactly once
every paid action uses the current observed complete-footprint guard
successor known-safe return including anchor heading fits remaining budget
final actual observation processed before logical close and reset
full raw replay and endpoint map agreement
return to initial pose without collision
interpretation: A failed gate remains a failure. Debugged revisions use a new output directory and source freeze. No F1, semantic efficacy, learned UQ, natural semantics, baseline superiority or ROS validation is inferred.
